_comment: Maps eToro symbols to TipRanks identifiers. Edit freely - ingest.py reads this file. TipRanks uses 'CC:TICKER' for non-US listings and 'XXXUSD' pairs for crypto.

VOD.note: Vodafone ADR (Nasdaq: VOD), priced in USD.

BABA.note: Alibaba ADR (NYSE: BABA), priced in USD.

ATROB.note: Astronics Class B (OTC). TipRanks has no analyst coverage for ATROB; consensus, price target and ratings live under ATRO (Class A, Nasdaq).

SHL.DE.note: Siemens Healthineers, XETRA, priced in EUR.

ETL.PA.note: Eutelsat, Euronext Paris, priced in EUR. No Smart Score on TipRanks.

SGB.note: TipRanks labels SGBUSD 'SubGame', not Songbird. The price is close to eToro's Songbird rate but the asset identity is unverified - treat as indicative only.
